headline: Haryana News: Haryana's Revenue System to Be Strengthened Without Raising Tax Rates; CM Nayab Saini Sets 10% Target by 2030
summary: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini said the state will strengthen its revenue through a wider tax base, better compliance and curbing revenue loss. The aim is to avoid extra burden on honest taxpayers.
why: State revenue capacity affects public borrowing needs and infrastructure spending, which matter to bond investors and contractors in Indian states.
